note: A reporting document, not a runtime authority: it never changes launcher capability detection or build admission. Format and rules: docs/product/compatibility-ledger.md.

platforms.name: Sega Genesis / Mega Drive
platforms.cpu_mode: generated-native MC68000 and generated-native Z80 (no interpreter, JIT or runtime opcode decoding)
capabilities: launcher library, build and play (Compatibility and Optimized build modes)
SDL3 viewer: pause menu, key/gamepad remapping, video effects, audio volume, F12 source-pixel screenshot, F3 performance overlay
widescreen Level 2 and Level 3, width control, Comfort/Borders/Raw side treatments, per-game presentation settings
automatic Sonic & Knuckles lock-on cartridge recognition (exact header match only)
opt-in static-first Z80 image production in the CLI (--z80-static 1)
limitations: two three-button pads; no six-button X/Y/Z/Mode input
execution is 60 Hz; the Europe PAL region choice changes the version register only
the viewer has no Genesis input recording or replay (headless pad scripts exist for development)
compatibility is incomplete: unlisted games may stop with a typed unsupported-behavior diagnostic or fail to build

platforms.name: Sega Master System
platforms.cpu_mode: generated-native Z80 (no interpreter, JIT or runtime opcode decoding)
capabilities: launcher library, build and play (Compatibility and Optimized build modes)
VDP, PSG, controllers with console Pause, SDL3 viewer with the shared pause menu and remapping
viewer input recording to a headless-replayable script (--viewer-record)
widescreen Level 2 and Level 3, always reported Partial
limitations: the cartridge mapper is declared by the user or a sidecar file, never guessed
widescreen cannot reveal more of the game world: the 256-pixel name table wraps and hardware sprite geometry limits Level 3 to a few edge pixels
192- and 224-line modes only

platforms.name: Sega CD / Mega-CD
platforms.cpu_mode: generated-native Main and Sub MC68000 plus a generated-native main-side Z80 (no interpreter, JIT or runtime opcode decoding)
capabilities: authentic user-supplied BIOS execution and CUE/BIN disc import (nothing bundled)
launcher build with automatic Compatibility and File-first (structural) modes, or import of a verified prebuilt program
CD-DA, RF5C164 PCM, YM2612 FM and PSG mixed in the viewer
viewer input recording and exact replay
widescreen Level 2 and Level 3, always reported Partial
limitations: complete CUE-to-play compilation is not claimed: code generated, decompressed or reached only through input the build never saw stops with a typed stop
FM/PSG output is not reference-checked and the audio mix level against CD-DA/PCM is not established
no 6-button pads or player 2 in the Sega CD viewer
no rewind, save states or cartridge-RAM expansion
